about: Hand-checked links from our Washington terminals (salish-terminals.json) to Washington DNR state-owned aquatic land use authorizations (lib/ships/dnrLeases.js) and, for the Whatcom County pilot, county shoreline permits at the dock (lib/ships/countyShoreline.js). DNR rule: a lease is accepted only when DNR's own lessee name carries the listed words (the terminal's operator or its permit holder of record) AND one of its DNR points lies within max_km (default 1 km) of a berth; a port management agreement (PMA) only when a berth lies inside DNR's PMA area polygon, or within max_metres of it where the terminal is that port's own terminal or names the area's site. Nothing is accepted by distance alone. Checked 2026-10-07 against the DNR AQ_ENC_Public_Prod map service read that day. Sources and catalogue: docs/DNR_LEASES.md.
